meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Cebu Leg 3 review: September 13 at SM Seaside -- the culminating leg with the signature 32K distance in Cebu City.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at SM Seaside, Cebu City, this is the third and final leg of the Cebu series within Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia, featuring the signature 32K distance alongside 5K, 10K and 21K.
verdict: Cebu Leg 3 closes out the local three-race progression within the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series, held at SM Seaside -- the Philippines' fifth-largest mall and Cebu's biggest waterfront commercial venue. The signature 32K distance sits alongside the standard 5K/10K/21K spread, following the same progressive structure used at the Iloilo and Manila legs in this series: shorter distances early in the calendar year, building to 32K by Leg 3, feeding into a National Finals qualification. Registration status for this specific leg isn't yet announced, and no independent participant feedback for the Cebu leg turned up in research, consistent with the pattern across this series' newer or less-publicised stops.

sections.heading: The Cebu Finale of a Progressive Series
paragraphs: Cebu Leg 3 offers 5K, 10K, 21K and the series' signature 32K distance, held at SM Seaside in Cebu City. [1] Like the Iloilo and Manila legs in this same 2026 Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series, the Cebu stops build progressively across the calendar year, with completion of the earlier legs' distances feeding toward a 42K qualification at the National Finals.

sections.heading: SM Seaside: Cebu's Biggest Waterfront Mall
paragraphs: SM Seaside City opened in November 2015 on Cebu's South Road Properties reclaimed waterfront, and as of 2025 is the second-largest mall in Cebu and the fifth-largest in the Philippines, with over 700 stores across roughly 470,000 square metres. [2] That scale gives Leg 3 a genuinely large-capacity venue for parking, staging, and post-race amenities, similar to how the series uses SM Mall of Asia for its Manila legs.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status for the Cebu Leg 3 specifically has not been announced. [1] Given that the Iloilo and Manila legs of the same series were already open for registration at the time of this research, it's worth checking RunRio's official channels directly for Cebu-specific updates rather than assuming a similar timeline.

sections.heading: No Independent Reviews Yet
paragraphs: No independent participant race reports or reviews for this Cebu leg turned up in research -- available material is limited to RunRio's own official site and race calendar. [1] That mirrors the review gap seen across other legs in this series researched in this batch, despite the series' overall scale and multi-year history.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you're working through the Trilogy series toward National Finals qualification, or simply want a large-scale race at one of Cebu's biggest waterfront venues, Cebu Leg 3 on 13 September 2026 fits the series' established format well.
